verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Ollama itself acting as an MCP client or letting users register MCP servers for its models to call. The pack only shows Ollama serving models to external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw. Any MCP support in those agents belongs to them, not to Ollama, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
